skill: Signposting a presentation and handling questions

words.def: a written agreement to use something (a car, property) for a set period in exchange for payment
words.ex: Read the {lease} carefully before you sign: some clauses are easy to miss.

words.def: to harm or break something so it is less useful or valuable
words.ex: If you {damage} the item, you may lose your deposit.

words.def: ready and available to use or collect right now
words.ex: They said there were still a few vans {on hand} for the weekend.

words.def: to go somewhere and get something that is waiting for you
words.ex: You can {collect} the keys from the front desk after two o'clock.

words.def: an extra charge you pay for breaking a rule
words.ex: There's a {penalty} if you return the car late.

words.def: gradual damage from normal everyday use
words.ex: Some {wear and tear} is expected, but big scratches are not.

words.def: not fixed to a strict end date or set conditions
words.ex: They offer an {open-ended} hire plan, so you can keep the car as long as you need.

words.def: to return something to the person or place you got it from
words.ex: Just {hand back} the keys at reception when you're done.
